title: Women in parliament
variable_name: Proportion of seats in national parliaments held by women [Sex=Female]
source: United Nations, SDG Global Database (United Nations Statistics Division); custodian: Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU)
retrieved_via: UN System Data Commons (MCP connector): get_observations(Earth, date=all); get_child_observations(parent=Earth, child_place_type=Country, date=latest)
notes: SDG target 5.5 (women's full and effective participation) sets no numeric value, so no pace or multiple is used; 50% is shown only as the parity reference. stats.json was computed without --target-value/--target-year, so its pace and trend fields refer to the script's default target and are not used. Country display names are the Data Commons place names as retrieved.

experiment.note: Experiment 001 stopped before any post (its Deviations, 1 Nov 2026); run-in of 002, then of 003 with template E (4 Nov 2026). Ground as 001 assigned; the repo link is the first comment on every network (JP, 3 Nov 2026).

subtitle: The proportion of seats held by women in national parliaments, currently as of 1 January of reporting year
